summary: Steep narrow lane with No Stopping signs and townhouses 3-7 m away.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs throughout

best_section.where: Flatter lower end of Union Street, beside the townhouse block

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 3-6 m from the kerb at this end; townhouse complexes either side.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with bush edges and no room to pull fully off; signed No Stopping Any Time.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane, but it links to a junction.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the lane.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs on both streets
Toowong Creek 96 m away, elevation 16-26 m
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by trees from the west and south.
